comparison.objective: Cut three hedge shoots with two-handed shears while sparing flowers; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual articulated-tool control, target selection and repeated cutting versus hex-bit insertion, setscrew torque, collar adjustment and response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: All shoots must be severed near target height, no flower cut, and shears returned closed; candidate passes on locked adjustment and two safe axial stops.
comparison.reason: Both manipulate an articulated mechanism with safety constraints, but cutting selective targets is materially different from tuning and validating a shock absorber.
